title: Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Pursuing Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent degree
description: Join Google for a 12-week summer internship where you will work on real-world projects, collaborate with full-time engineers, and build scalable software solutions.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Non-UK citizens applying to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge.
qualification: Outstanding academic record and strong leadership potential
description: The Gates Cambridge Scholarship offers full funding for outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree in any subject available at the University of Cambridge.

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
eligibility: Open to young professionals with 1+ year of frontend web development experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in CS/IT or equivalent project portfolio
description: Canonical is seeking a Remote Frontend Developer to work on user interfaces for Ubuntu and Canonical web products using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

title: Associate Business Analyst
eligibility: Recent graduates or final-year university students in Business, Finance, or Analytics.
qualification: Bachelor's in Business Administration, Economics, or Data Analytics
description: Work directly with enterprise clients to analyze business processes, develop data-driven strategy recommendations, and implement digital transformation initiatives.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16 or older enrolled in an accredited high school or university.
description: The global student technology competition where teams build innovative solutions using Microsoft Azure cloud services to make a positive impact on the world.

title: IBM Data Science Professional Certificate
eligibility: Open to all students and beginners with no prior coding experience required.
description: Master job-ready skills in Python, SQL, data visualization, and machine learning through a series of hands-on courses designed by IBM data science professionals.
